content: Figure FIGREF32 shows the most important result of our analysis: the benefits of our method, explicitly designed to deal with longer documents, do actually become stronger as we apply it to longer documents. As it can be seen in Figure FIGREF32 , the performance gain of our model with respect to current state-of-the-art extractive summarizer is more pronounced for documents with INLINEFORM0 words in both datasets.
